text:
jess: Heads-up: release cutoff in ~2h (18:00 PT). I have a docs-only version bump PR (redwood/redwood#7892) that needs a late-merge exception if it's allowed. It's just changelog + version bump (0.17.3 -> 0.17.4). Any objections? /cc @leo @maya
ankur: If it's docs-only and no binary change, usually fine as patch. Confirm there are no packaging changes.
jess: No packaging, just CHANGELOG + setup.cfg version. CI green, small lint fix included. Link: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/7892
leo: Pinged changelog owners. @maya can you confirm changelog approval? Also, reminder: for late-merge we need approval from release leads + a signed off changelog entry.
maya: I approve changelog wording. For late-merge exception: please open the 'freeze-exceptions' form (link). Checklist I need in PR description:
```
- reason: docs-only
- risk: none
- tested: CI green
- rollback plan: revert PR
```
I'll +1 once updated. Also we may need a release lead sign-off (tag @ankur).
release-bot: freeze-exception reminder: Cutoff is at 18:00 PT. To request exception, add label `freeze-exception` and fill form: https://go/release-exception. Current open exceptions: 2.
ankur: ack. @jess can you add the checklist and label? If release lead approves, we can merge right after cutoff with a manual stamp.
jess: Done — added checklist, labeled `freeze-exception`. Thanks everyone. I'll wait for @ankur sign-off then merge.
leo: :thumbsup: Will update the changelog owners doc to note this patch. Good to keep it small.
maya: If we don't get sign-off by cutoff, we'll queue for post-cutoff hotpatch window. Not expected but FYI.
jess: Understood. Thanks all.
